reasoning: In March 2016, Google DeepMind's artificial intelligence program, AlphaGo, defeated Lee Sedol—a legendary 9-dan professional Go player and 18-time world champion—by a score of 4 games to 1 in a historic five-game match. Prior to AlphaGo's success (which first became public when it defeated European champion Fan Hui in late 2015), the consensus among AI researchers and Go experts was that a computer defeating a top-tier human professional Go player was at least a decade away, making this achievement about ten years ahead of schedule.
